1: // Meteor Shower Escape – minimal implementation
2: (function(){
3:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
4:   // Audio context for sound effects
5:   const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
6:   // Ensure audio can start after user interaction
7:   const resumeAudio = () => { audioCtx.state === 'suspended' && audioCtx.resume(); };
8:   window.addEventListener('keydown', resumeAudio, {once:true});
9:   function playTone(freq, duration){
10:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
11:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
12:     osc.frequency.value = freq;
13:     osc.type = 'sine';
14:     osc.connect(gain);
15:     gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
16:     const now = audioCtx.currentTime;
17:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.001, now);
18:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.2, now + 0.01);
19:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, now + duration/1000);
20:     osc.start(now);
21:     osc.stop(now + duration/1000);
22:   }
23: 
24:   if (!canvas) { console.error('Canvas with id "game" not found'); return; }
25:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
26:   // Ensure canvas size (fallback to 800x600)
27:   canvas.width = canvas.width || 800;
28:   canvas.height = canvas.height || 600;
29: 
30:   const ship = { width: 40, height: 20, x: canvas.width/2, y: canvas.height-30, speed: 6 };
31:   let moveLeft = false, moveRight = false;
32:   const meteors = [];
33:   const stars = []; // pre‑generated starfield
34:   // generate starfield once
35:   (function generateStars(){
36:     const starCount = 120;
37:     for(let i=0;i<starCount;i++){
38:       stars.push({
39:         x: Math.random()*canvas.width,
40:         y: Math.random()*canvas.height,
41:         size: Math.random()*2+0.5,
42:         alpha: Math.random()*0.5+0.5
43:       });
44:     }
45:   })();
46:   let lastSpawn = 0, spawnInterval = 1500; // ms
47:   let startTime = performance.now();
48:   let gameOver = false;
49:   let score = 0;
50: 
51:   // Input handling
52:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e=>{ if(e.key==='ArrowLeft'){ moveLeft=true; playTone(180,60); } if(e.key==='ArrowRight'){ moveRight=true; playTone(180,60); } });
53:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e=>{ if(e.key==='ArrowLeft') moveLeft=false; if(e.key==='ArrowRight') moveRight=false; });
54: 
55:   function spawnMeteor(){
56:     const radius = Math.random()*15+10;
57:     const speed = Math.random()*2+1 + (performance.now()-startTime)/60000; // increase over time
58:     meteors.push({ x: Math.random()*canvas.width, y: -radius, r: radius, dy: speed });
59:     // play spawn sound (high‑pitched swoosh)
60:     playTone(300 + Math.random()*200, 80);
61:   }
62: 
63:   function update(dt){
64:     // Ship movement
65:     if(moveLeft) ship.x -= ship.speed;
66:     if(moveRight) ship.x += ship.speed;
67:     ship.x = Math.max(0, Math.min(canvas.width-ship.width, ship.x));
68: 
69:     // Spawn meteors
70:     if(performance.now() - lastSpawn > spawnInterval){
71:       spawnMeteor();
72:       lastSpawn = performance.now();
73:       // gradually increase difficulty
74:       spawnInterval = Math.max(300, spawnInterval*0.98);
75:     }
76: 
77:     // Update meteors
78:     for(let i=meteors.length-1;i>=0;i--){
79:       const m = meteors[i];
80:       m.y += m.dy;
81:       // collision with ship (simple AABB vs circle)
82:       const shipRect = {x: ship.x, y: ship.y, w: ship.width, h: ship.height};
83:       const distX = Math.abs(m.x - (shipRect.x + shipRect.w/2));
84:       const distY = Math.abs(m.y - (shipRect.y + shipRect.h/2));
85:       if(distX > (shipRect.w/2 + m.r) || distY > (shipRect.h/2 + m.r)) {
86:         // no collision
87:         } else {
88:           // collision detected
89:           gameOver = true;
90:           // collision sound: low note
91:           playTone(100, 300);
92:         }
93:       // remove off‑screen meteors
94:       if(m.y - m.r > canvas.height) meteors.splice(i,1);
95:     }
96: 
97:     // Update score
98:     score = Math.floor((performance.now() - startTime)/1000);
99:   }
100: 
101:   function draw(){
102:     ctx.clearRect(0,0,canvas.width,canvas.height);
103:     // background gradient
104:     const bgGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,canvas.height);
105:     bgGrad.addColorStop(0, '#001d3d');
106:     bgGrad.addColorStop(1, '#000814');
107:     ctx.fillStyle = bgGrad;
108:     ctx.fillRect(0,0,canvas.width,canvas.height);
109:     // pre‑generated starfield with twinkling
110:     stars.forEach(star => {
111:       // slight flicker
112:       star.alpha += (Math.random()-0.5)*0.02;
113:       star.alpha = Math.max(0.3, Math.min(1, star.alpha));
114:       ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,255,255,${star.alpha})`;
115:       ctx.fillRect(star.x, star.y, star.size, star.size);
116:     });
117:     // ship (gradient triangle with outline)
118:     const shipGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, ship.y, 0, ship.y + ship.height);
119:     shipGrad.addColorStop(0, '#00ff7f');
120:     shipGrad.addColorStop(1, '#006400');
121:     ctx.fillStyle = shipGrad;
122:     ctx.beginPath();
123:     ctx.moveTo(ship.x, ship.y + ship.height);
124:     ctx.lineTo(ship.x + ship.width/2, ship.y);
125:     ctx.lineTo(ship.x + ship.width, ship.y + ship.height);
126:     ctx.closePath();
127:     ctx.fill();
128:     // ship outline glow
129:     ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(0,255,127,0.6)';
130:     ctx.lineWidth = 2;
131:     ctx.stroke();
132:     // meteors with radial gradient
133:     meteors.forEach(m=>{
134:       const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(m.x, m.y, m.r*0.2, m.x, m.y, m.r);
135:       grad.addColorStop(0, '#ffae42');
136:       grad.addColorStop(1, '#c1440e');
137:       ctx.fillStyle = grad;
138:       ctx.beginPath();
139:       ctx.arc(m.x, m.y, m.r, 0, Math.PI*2);
140:       ctx.fill();
141:       // optional glow effect
142:       ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(255,140,0,0.5)';
143:       ctx.shadowBlur = 8;
144:       ctx.fill();
145:       ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
146:     });
147:     // score
148:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
149:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
150:     ctx.fillText('Score: '+score, 10, 20);
151:     // game over overlay
152:     if(gameOver){
153:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
154:       ctx.fillRect(0,0,canvas.width,canvas.height);
155:       ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
156:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
157:       ctx.font = '48px sans-serif';
158:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', canvas.width/2, canvas.height/2);
159:       ctx.font = '24px sans-serif';
160:       ctx.fillText('Final Score: '+score, canvas.width/2, canvas.height/2+40);
161:     }
162:   }
163: 
164:   let lastTime = 0;
165:   function loop(timestamp){
166:     const dt = timestamp - lastTime;
167:     lastTime = timestamp;
168:     if(!gameOver){
169:       update(dt);
170:     }
171:     draw();
172:     if(!gameOver) requestAnimationFrame(loop);
173:   }
174:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
175: })();
